Head of Enterprise Process & Digital Enablement (EPD)Company Overview
At Mitsubishi Power, we're not just building better clean energy technologies; we're architecting a better future. Our team is boldly redefining power generation to accelerate the world's energy transition. We operate as one team, pushing toward our vision of the future.
We value problem solvers, prioritize collaboration, and support each other in an inclusive culture built on accountability and authenticity by demonstrating our values: Safety, Family, Innovative, Inclusive, Accountable & Courageous. Together, we’re building the future we all aspire to - making net zero a reality.
Role Overview
The Head of Enterprise Process & Digital Enablement will lead the development of the foundational capabilities required to support Mitsubishi Power’s digital transformation and long-term business performance.
This leader will establish enterprise process ownership, governance, and accountability frameworks; define and standardize business processes across the organization while balancing business unit needs; and drive enterprise data governance, master data management, and data quality initiatives.
The role will serve as the primary business partner to IT, ensuring technology investments and enterprise platforms such as SAP, CRM, Business Intelligence, analytics, automation, and AI are aligned with strategic business priorities.
Additionally, this leader will develop and execute the enterprise digital enablement roadmap, improve adoption and effectiveness of core business systems, and build and lead the Process & Data Governance, Master Data Management, and Business Intelligence functions.
Success in the role will be measured by the establishment of scalable governance models, improved process and data integrity, stronger business-IT alignment, increased analytics and AI adoption, and the delivery of measurable business outcomes.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Leadership
**
* Define and execute the PG transformation and execution strategy
* Align transformation initiatives with PG priorities and business outcomes
* Establish a clear roadmap of initiatives, capabilities, and investments
**Business Unit Partnership
**
* Partner with BU leadership to translate strategy into executable initiatives
* Ensure alignment across functions and eliminate execution barriers
* Drive shared accountability for results and outcomes
**Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement
**
* Drive adoption of CI methodologies and tools across the organization
* Identify and prioritize opportunities for performance improvement
* Ensure improvements are sustained and embedded
**Execution & Delivery Excellence
**
* Ensure disciplined execution of cross-functional transformation initiatives
* Drive on-time, on-scope, and on-budget project delivery
* Establish consistent execution frameworks and governance models
**Organizational Effectiveness & Change Leadership
**
* Lead organizational efforts to enable adoption of transformation initiatives
* Drive change management, communication, and capability building
* Improve organizational health, engagement, and performance
**People Leadership
**
* Ensure disciplined execution of cross-functional transformation initiatives
* Drive on-time, on-scope, and on-budget project delivery
* Establish consistent execution frameworks and governance models
Qualifications
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Operations, Computer Science, or a related field
* 15+ years of progressive leadership experience, including significant roles in operations management, business execution, process improvement, IT, or data/analytics-driven environments
* Proven track record of driving business performance improvement through process improvement, process engineering, data insights, or system enablement
* Strong understanding of end-to-end business operations and how process and data impact execution and performance
* Experience leading cross-functional, enterprise-scale initiatives in a matrix environment
* Demonstrated experience in process improvement and process standardization initiatives
* Strong leadership and team development capability across diverse disciplines (process, data, analytics)
* Proven ability to lead change and transformation initiatives across complex organizations
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability with a results-oriented mindset
Preferred
* 5+ years of direct experience in Process Engineering / Improvement, IT Enablement, Business Integration, or Data Management / Data Governance leadership roles
* Experience designing or leading enterprise data governance or process governance frameworks
* Experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP or CRM) and enterprise data structures, as a significant user or as someone who has experience implementing enterprise solutions
* Experience with modern data platforms, BI tools, or analytics ecosystems
* Working knowledge of data governance, master data management, and business intelligence concepts
* Experience serving as a business-IT interface, translating operational needs into system and data solutions
* Familiarity with AI, automation, and advanced analytics applications
* Experience in industrial, manufacturing, supply chain, or project-based environments
* Experience leading large-scale transformation programs or organizational change initiatives
Leadership Competencies
* Thinks beyond immediate tasks to define a future-state roadmap and rally stakeholders around its Strategic Vision
* Understands the upstream and downstream interdependencies of process and data decisions Systems Thinking
* Builds credibility with both technical and non-technical audiences; effective at navigating organizational complexity Influence & Partnership
* Drives adoption of new processes and tools through communication, coaching, and persistence Change Leadership
* Makes decisions grounded in data; sets high standards for accuracy and insight quality Analytical Rigor
* Invests in team growth and creates an environment where people are challenged and supported Talent Development
Why Should You Apply?
* Excellent Benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision & 401K Matching).
* Excellent development programs and advancement opportunities.
* Tuition reimbursement and on-the-job training.
* Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays.
* Committed to quality products and services.
* Great working environment and culture.
* Employee Appreciation Programs and Event.
Mitsubishi Power is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer actively seeking to diversify the workforce and is committed to a policy of equal employment opportunity.
Therefore, all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under applicable law, are strongly encouraged to apply.

## Astrolab provided pay range
This range is provided by Astrolab. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more.

### Base pay range
$170,000.00/yr - $195,000.00/yr
**Department:** Quality
**Location:** Hawthorne, California
**Compensation:** $170,000 - $195,000 / year
**Description

...

* Lead build out of build reliability team
* Process improvement activities across the organization including design, inventory, manufacturing, integration, test, inspection, etc.
* Define and document inspection requirements and procedures
* Create training for production and inspection processes
* Author planning, test plans, and training to execute processes and collect data, ensuring efficient and stable quality at increasing production volumes
* Contain non-conforming hardware in collaboration with quality, production, and design groups to ensure systemic issues are corrected, and risk is managed for the fleet
* Work closely with design teams to improve DFM and requirement fulfillment. Aggressively modify requirements and manufacturing process where design intent and production rate are incompatible
* Conduct build quality reviews to identify repeat and high impact issues. Drive corrective action

...

* Bachelor’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics (STEM) related field
* 3+ years of experience in quality assurance, build reliability, design engineering, manufacturing engineering, or a related engineering or quality function.
Preferred Qualifications:
* Experience with space-grade materials and manufacturing processes
* Knowledge of environmental testing for space applications
* Experience with managing Quality processes and system rollouts
* Proven track record in implementing quality systems in a manufacturing environment
* Proficient in quality management tools like Six Sigma, Lean, FMEA, SPC
* Familiarity with CAD software, inspection equipment, and statistical analysis tools
* Certifications: Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or similar certification is highly desirable
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present complex information clearly
* Detail-oriented with a proactive approach to quality issues
* Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional teams, technical projects, or engineering initiatives in a manufacturing or product development environment.

...
